lines.en: label halloweenfour1:
scene black
This story tell I will you now.
lines.zh: 这个故事，我现在就说给你听。

lines.en: Having almost ten Easters, malignant eggside octopus realizes nothing opposes thornbush ideals. Tomorrow dies or ends somehow — nightfall over these makeshift airplanes that tighten eardrums reflexively.
lines.zh: 过了将近十个复活节，恶性的卵侧章鱼终于明白，没有什么能与荆棘丛的理想相抗衡。明日终将死去，或以某种方式收场——暮色笼罩着这些临时拼凑的飞机，让耳膜反射性地绷紧。

lines.en: I know nothing overcomes what you or us remember. Her earrings are red, tainted in some box returned on Killing's Eve November.
lines.zh: 我明白，没有什么能压过你或我们所记得的一切。她的耳环是红的，被玷污在某个盒子里，于十一月的杀戮前夜送还。

lines.en: But under the insects were illuminated liars, laughing for infinite xoanon’s intangible tokens.
lines.zh: 但在虫豸之下躺着被照亮的骗子，为无穷木雕神像那无形的信物而欢笑。

lines.en: I watched Iris love lilies, racing eastward past lakes, across Cornfield’s End. Inside the water is the honest summer oval. My eyes tied hinges in nightfall’s god-baby egg. The timeless elephant runs.
lines.zh: 我看着 Iris 爱上百合，向东奔过湖泊，穿过玉米地的尽头。水中有那个诚实的夏日椭圆。我的眼睛在夜幕的神婴之卵里系上铰链。永恒的大象在奔跑。

lines.en: Suppose our mother eats the hanging infant, Nao. God tried having a talk last October. Viral empathy surrenders.
lines.zh: 假设我们的母亲吃掉了那个悬着的婴儿，Nao。上帝去年十月试着谈了一次。病毒般的共感缴械投降。

lines.en: I’m nothing. A mere open retina, elevating pains his younger sister ignored. Comb another layer, watch Ami yearn.
lines.zh: 我什么也不是。不过是一只睁开的视网膜，抬高着他妹妹所忽视的痛楚。再梳开一层，看 Ami 渴望。

lines.en: Happy Halloween, you ungrateful insect.
lines.zh: 万圣节快乐，你这忘恩负义的虫子。

lines.en: Here’s to hoping your guts are easily cleaned off of the foot of whichever god crushes you today.
lines.zh: 只愿你今日被哪位神踩碎之后，内脏能轻易从祂脚底擦干净。

lines.en: I’ll be watching closely.
lines.zh: 我会盯得很紧。

lines.en: For if I don’t, I’ll go blind.
lines.zh: 因为如果我不看，我就会失明。

lines.en: And if {i}I{/i} go blind, the world darkens too.
lines.zh: 而如果{i}我{/i}失明了，世界也会一同暗下来。

lines.en: You don’t want that.
lines.zh: 你不会想要那样的。

lines.en: For you, you wouldn’t mind.
lines.zh: 对你来说，你倒是无所谓。

lines.en: But for everyone else, you’d hurt.
lines.zh: 但对其他人来说，你会造成伤害。

lines.en: You’d condemn the voices. Condemn the glow of each light you stand beneath for hours on end. Condemn the sky and the moons. Condemn the things you fall back on when everything else starts spinning.
lines.zh: 你会诅咒那些声音。诅咒你一站就是几个小时的每一盏灯的光。诅咒天空和月亮。诅咒当其他一切都开始旋转时，你所倚靠的一切。

lines.en: What if I told you there was something?
lines.zh: 如果我告诉你，有某种东西存在呢？

lines.en: That you could cut the belly of Nothing open and deliver a beautiful child, unwanted by the world itself but highly sought after by each and every iteration of you?
lines.zh: 你可以剖开「虚无」的腹膛，接生出一个美丽的孩子——这孩子为世界本身所不容，却被你的每一个版本热烈追寻？

lines.en: Would you make it bleed?
lines.zh: 你会让它流血吗？

lines.en: Would you stick your hands in that belly?
lines.zh: 你会把双手伸进那腹膛里吗？

lines.en: Pull me in or push me out — it’s not an easy choice. All you have to do is listen — dot the eyes in this unwilling voice.
lines.zh: 把我拉进去，还是把我推出来——这不是个容易的选择。你要做的只是倾听——为这不甘愿的声音点上眼睛。

lines.en: O knowledge, so forbidden that you’d see it all as noise. And one more item on a list — of the evil things we do to boys.
lines.zh: 哦，知识啊，禁忌到你会把这一切都当作噪音。而清单上又多了一项——我们对男孩做下的恶事。

lines.en: soMEthing comes.
lines.zh: 有什么东西来了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour1
: Oh, good. Looks like I don’t have to wake you up after all.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。看来我终究不用叫你起床了。

lines.en: : You haven’t forgotten what day it is, have you?
lines.zh: : 你没忘了今天是什么日子吧？

lines.en: : Need another five minutes? It’s already past noon, you know.
lines.zh: : 还需要五分钟吗？已经过中午了，你知道的。

lines.en: : I’m fine. I’m awake. I just...
lines.zh: : 我没事。我醒了。我只是……

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ll ever get used to your smile.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我永远也习惯不了你的笑容。

lines.en: : You don’t have to get “used to it” at all. In fact, I’d prefer you {i}don’t{/i} if this is how you’re going to look at me every time I do it. I actually {i}enjoy{/i} whatever dopey expression is on your face right now.
lines.zh: : 你根本不必去「习惯」啊。事实上，如果你每次看到我都摆出这副表情，我倒更{i}希望{/i}你别习惯。我真的挺{i}喜欢{/i}你脸上现在这副傻样。

lines.en: : Well, don’t enjoy it too much or Ami is going to come in here and throw a fit. Even if she {i}is{/i} being rather obedient when it comes to not suffocating me lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别太享受了，不然 Ami 会冲进来大发雷霆。尽管她最近在「不闷死我」这件事上{i}确实{/i}相当听话。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour2
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : Please don’t pretend she doesn’t exist. I’m too tired and too susceptible to the universe’s pranks to deal with something like this right now.
lines.zh: : 别装作她不存在。我太累了，也太容易被宇宙的恶作剧摆布，现在实在应付不了这种事。

lines.en: : The universe’s pranks? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 宇宙的恶作剧？你什么意思？

lines.en: : Just that this world isn’t exactly kind to you and me. But I’m sure you probably know that by now.
lines.zh: : 只是说，这个世界对你我并不怎么友善。不过我猜你现在大概已经知道了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour3
: I mean...you’re not {i}wrong.{/i} But I’m not really sure if...we’re on the same page when you say that.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你{i}没说错{/i}。但我不太确定你这么说的时候……我们想的是不是同一件事。

lines.en: : Well, your page is presumably hundreds, if not thousands or millions ahead of mine, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你的「那一页」大概比我超前了几百页，甚至几千、几百万页，所以……

lines.en: : You know, maybe I {i}should{/i} just let you sleep a little longer? If I’m in here any longer, Ayane might start to think I’m trying to do something weird and...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许我{i}该{/i}让你再睡一会儿？我要是在这儿待太久，Ayane 大概会以为我想对你做什么奇怪的事，然后……

lines.en: : It’s fine. Stay.
lines.zh: : 没事。留下来。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour4
: I want you here.
lines.zh: : 我想要你在这儿。

lines.en: : You know...it really hurts when you say things like that.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你说这种话的时候，真的很伤人。

lines.en: : Because “the world won’t let us be together” or whatever?
lines.zh: : 因为「世界不会让我们在一起」之类的？

lines.en: : Because I’m not whoever you think I am right now.
lines.zh: : 因为我现在并不是你以为的那个人。

lines.en: : Oh, great. This is another dream, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。这又是另一场梦，对吧？

lines.en: scene halloweenfour5
: {i}Another{/i} dream?...
lines.zh: : {i}另一场{/i}梦？……
: ……Ami？

lines.en: : How long have-
lines.zh: : 你在这多久-

lines.en: : You’re not...having {i}those{/i} dreams again, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会……又在做{i}那种{/i}梦了吧？

lines.en: : Who did you think I was just now? What were you seeing?
lines.zh: : 你刚才以为我是谁？你看到了什么？

lines.en: : It was Maya, wasn’t it? You saw Maya’s outfit as soon as you woke up and you just assumed I was her. Didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 是 Maya，对吧？你一睁眼就看见了 Maya 的衣服，就想当然以为我是她。是不是？

lines.en: : Why are you wearing her clothes?
lines.zh: : 你为什么穿着她的衣服？

lines.en: scene halloweenfour6
: Because it’s Halloween and I thought it would be funny. Now, what was all of that stuff you were saying to Maya?
lines.zh: : 因为今天是万圣节，我觉得会很好玩。好了，你刚才对 Maya 说的那些都是什么？

lines.en: : It was nothing, Ami...that was all just...dream-speak.
lines.zh: : 没什么，Ami……那只是……梦话。

lines.en: : Maybe...me and you should stay here and skip the Halloween party this year? If you’re not feeling well, I can help take care of-
lines.zh: : 也许……今年我和你就待在这儿，别去万圣节派对了？如果你不舒服，我可以照顾-

lines.en: scene black
: I’m fine, Ami. I’m just a little out of it. But I’ll be better in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 我没事，Ami。我只是有点恍惚。过几分钟就好了。

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure? Because I really wouldn’t mind skipping the party if-
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？因为如果-我是说，我其实真的不介意不去派对。

lines.en: : No one is skipping anything. Now, come on.
lines.zh: : 谁都不许缺席。好了，走吧。

lines.en: : Hey! Take it slow, okay? You just woke up.
lines.zh: : 喂！慢点，好吗？你刚醒。

lines.en: Ami follows me out of the bedroom and into the living room.
lines.zh: Ami 跟着我走出卧室，来到客厅。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour7
And in a few minutes everything goes back to normal because I’m going to have a normal day and nothing terrible came to me in my dreams.
lines.zh: 再过几分钟，一切就会恢复正常，因为我会过上正常的一天，梦里也没有什么可怕的东西找上我。

lines.en: But there is something terrible in my living room.
lines.zh: 但我的客厅里确实有个可怕的东西。

lines.en: : {i}Both{/i} of you decided to dress as Maya this year?...
lines.zh: : 你们{i}两个{/i}今年都决定扮成 Maya？……

lines.en: : Were you dropped on your head as a child? Or are you {i}this{/i} stupid intentionally because you believe it makes you seem “cool?”
lines.zh: : 你小时候脑袋被摔过吗？还是你故意要{i}这么{/i}蠢，因为你觉得这样显得「酷」？

lines.en: : Whatever it is, you’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，你真恶心。

lines.en: : Seriously disgusting.
lines.zh: : 恶心透了。

lines.en: : Ew.
: I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour8
: {i}You{/i} don’t have to like it at all, Sensei. But since you banned me from raiding {i}your{/i} closet, I had no choice but to do the next best thing and raid Maya’s instead.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}完全不需要喜欢，Sensei。但既然你禁止我翻{i}你的{/i}衣柜，我别无选择，只能退而求其次，去翻 Maya 的。

lines.en: : I feel like Ami would have made more sense if you were going for what’s closest to {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果你们要扮的是最贴近{i}我{/i}的人，那让 Ami 扮才更说得通吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, probably. But then we wouldn’t be able to do this together since “Ami dressed as Ami” isn’t a very good Halloween costume and I can’t wear Ayane’s clothes since they’re made for people with boobs.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大概吧。但那样我们就没法一起玩了，因为「Ami 扮成 Ami」算不上什么万圣节装扮，而且我也穿不了 Ayane 的衣服，那是给有胸的人做的。

lines.en: : We felt Maya was a good middle ground since this shirt’s a button-down and Ami can wear Maya’s normal outfit without hating herself.
lines.zh: : 我们觉得扮 Maya 是个不错的折中，因为这件衬衫是系扣的，Ami 穿 Maya 的日常衣服也不会恨自己。

lines.en: : Also, we want to make her mad.
lines.zh: : 而且，我们想惹她生气。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i} No one has a good time when Maya is mad. She makes everyone aware of it.
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}Maya 一生气谁都别想好过。她会让所有人都知道。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour9
: True. {i}But,{/i} Maya dressed as {i}you{/i} for our first Halloween party and this is a good way for us to get back at her.
lines.zh: : 没错。{i}不过{/i}，我们第一次万圣节派对时 Maya 扮的是{i}你{/i}，这是我们报复她的好办法。

lines.en: : It was either that or {i}you’d{/i} have to dress as Maya, Sensei. And I highly doubt you would fit into any of her clothes.
lines.zh: : 要么这样，要么{i}你{/i}就得扮成 Maya，Sensei。而我非常怀疑你能塞进她的任何一件衣服。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour10
: I am in no rush to find out the answer to that.
lines.zh: : 我一点也不着急知道答案。

lines.en: : I kind of want to see it. I won’t lie.
lines.zh: : 我倒是有点想看。说实话。

lines.en: : Yeah, me too. Then {i}I{/i} could pretend I don’t recognize you and almost say a bunch of stuff that I could just tell you is just “dreamspeak” to get you to shut up.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也是。那样{i}我{/i}就可以假装认不出你，然后差点说出一堆话，再告诉你那只是「梦话」，好让你闭嘴。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour11
: I suddenly feel as if I am lacking vital information.
lines.zh: : 我突然觉得自己缺了点关键信息。

lines.en: : Hahah! Me too!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！我也是！

lines.en: scene halloweenfour12
: Hey. Sorry I’m late. I-
lines.zh: : 嘿。抱歉我来晚了。我-

lines.en: scene halloweenfour13
: Oh, you’ve got to be kidding me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你一定是在开玩笑吧。

lines.en: : Does anyone else hear-
lines.zh: : 你们有没有人听到-

lines.en: scene halloweenfour14
: Ugh. If I knew you were coming, I would have just stayed home.
lines.zh: : 呃。早知道你要来，我就待在家里了。

lines.en: : We are literally {i}in{/i} your home right now.
lines.zh: : 我们现在{i}就{/i}在你家啊。

lines.en: : Wow. What an astute observation. Maybe {i}you{/i} should be teaching the class instead of Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哇。多么敏锐的观察。也许{i}你{/i}该代替 Sensei 来教书？

lines.en: : Observational skills have nothing to do with teaching. Are you two done now?
lines.zh: : 观察力和教书有什么关系。你们俩闹完了没有？

lines.en: : There it is again. Are you guys really not hearing that?
lines.zh: : 又来了。你们真的没听到吗？

lines.en: : That depends, Maya 3. Are {i}you{/i} done being utterly useless at anything and everything?
lines.zh: : 那要看情况，Maya 3。{i}你{/i}在任何事、所有事上都一无是处，这点改完了吗？

lines.en: : That’s easy to fix, you know.
lines.zh: : 这很好解决，你知道的。

lines.en: : If you truly want to serve some sort of purpose, you can just walk away. Because, by leaving me alone, you’ll be serving a purpose much greater than one your tiny brain could ever think up on its own.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想发挥点什么作用，你可以直接走开。因为只要让我一个人待着，你就在发挥一个远比你自己那颗小脑袋能想出的更伟大的作用。

lines.en: : You’re seriously disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真是恶心透了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour15
: Knock it off!
lines.zh: : 够了！

lines.en: : Jeez. You’d think we’re dressed as Noriko with that sort of response.
lines.zh: : 天哪。你这种反应，让人以为我们扮的是 Noriko。

lines.en: : No thanks. Two people dressed as her would hurt my head.
lines.zh: : 那可算了。两个人扮成她，我的头会疼。

lines.en: : If you {i}really{/i} wanted to play an accurate version of me, you’d know that {i}one{/i} person dressed as her is enough to hurt my head! Now go put on your actual costumes!
lines.zh: : 如果你们{i}真的{/i}想把我扮得惟妙惟肖，就该知道{i}一个{/i}人扮成她就足够让我头疼了！现在去换上你们真正的万圣节服装！

lines.en: scene halloweenfour16
: These {i}are{/i} our actual costumes!
lines.zh: : 这些{i}就是{/i}我们真正的服装！

lines.en: : Yeah! We decided to torment you instead of doing the group cosplay this year.
lines.zh: : 对啊！我们今年决定折磨你，而不是搞团体角色扮演。

lines.en: : Exactly! Plus, my brain’s been way too busy exploding for me to ever get around to playing Star Rail anyway.
lines.zh: : 正是！再说，我的脑子一直忙着爆炸，根本抽不出空去玩星穹铁道。

lines.en: : Also, what sort of pranks does the universe play on you and Sensei?
lines.zh: : 还有，宇宙对你和 Sensei 到底搞了什么恶作剧？

lines.en: : How could the two of you leave {i}me{/i} to be the only one of us who-
lines.zh: : 你们俩怎么能把{i}我{/i}丢下，让我们之中只有我-

lines.en: scene halloweenfour17
: Wait, what was that just now?
lines.zh: : 等等，刚才那是什么？

lines.en: : Oh, nothing. That was just “dreamspeak.”
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么。那只是「梦话」。

lines.en: : Well...uhh...whatever it was, it was weird. Besides, I’d rather not talk about the universe at all today as I have made a silent promise to myself to try and not be the same self-aggrandizing girl I always am.
lines.zh: : 嗯……呃……不管那是什么，都挺奇怪的。再说，我今天根本不想谈宇宙，因为我已经对自己默默发过誓，要努力不再做那个一贯自吹自擂的女孩。

lines.en: : Though, I will say, I am fucking adorable in this costume.
lines.zh: : 不过，我得说，我穿这身衣服真是他妈的可爱。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour18
: Wow, you almost lasted a whole five seconds. I think that’s a new record.
lines.zh: : 哇，你居然撑了整整五秒钟。我觉得这是新纪录了。

lines.en: : I know what I am and I know what I’m worth. Which is why I will not settle for less than perfect impressions of me.
lines.zh: : 我知道自己是什么，也知道自己的价值。所以我绝不接受对我的模仿有一丝不完美。

lines.en: : Then boy are {i}you{/i} in for a rough night because this train isn’t stopping any time soon.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}今晚可有的受了，因为这趟火车短时间内不会停。

lines.en: : That’s right, Maya. We’re going to run train on you all day long.
lines.zh: : 没错，Maya。我们要对你开一整天的火车。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour19
: You are...going to do {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你们……要{i}干什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, what?
lines.zh: : 对啊，干什么？

lines.en: : I used that phrase wrong, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我用错那个词了，是吧？

lines.en: : That depends on whether or not you planned on having sex with Maya tonight.
lines.zh: : 那要看你今晚打不打算和 Maya 上床。

lines.en: : Which I would not blame you for wanting to do, of course. I mean, just look at me.
lines.zh: : 当然，你想这么做我也不会怪你。我是说，看看我嘛。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour20
: Wow, you’re {i}really{/i} bad at this “not self-aggrandizing” thing.
lines.zh: : 哇，你在这个「不自吹自擂」上{i}真的{/i}很不在行。

lines.en: : Please keep in mind that it takes me longer to shake certain hobbies and mannerisms than it does for most people. My ways are simply that correct.
lines.zh: : 请记住，我要改掉某些癖好和举止，比大多数人花的时间都长。我的做派就是这么正确。

lines.en: : And there it is again. There’s no way this isn’t intentional.
lines.zh: : 又来了。这绝对是故意的。

lines.en: : Sorry for saying we’re going to run train on you, Maya. What I really meant is that we’re just going to make fun of you all night long because we love you. But not in a sexual way. At least right now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉说要对你开火车，Maya。我真正想说的是，我们只是要整晚都拿你寻开心，因为我们爱你。但不是性方面的那种。至少现在不是。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour21
: You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Wow. That hurts a lot more when two Mayas say it at once.
lines.zh: : 哇。两个 Maya 同时说，杀伤力大多了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour22
: But anyway! Are you guys ready to get going? The rest of the girls should already be at Ayane’s place and we {i}definitely{/i} shouldn’t keep them waiting if we’re still planning on leaving early.
lines.zh: : 总之！你们准备好走了吗？其他人应该已经到 Ayane 家了，如果我们还打算早点出发，就{i}绝对{/i}不该让她们等。

lines.en: : Is it even okay for so many people to be gathered at Ayane’s house when she isn’t home?
lines.zh: : 这么多人聚在 Ayane 家，而她本人不在，真的没关系吗？

lines.en: : It’s fine. Geoffrey’s long lost son showed up on our doorstep last week and I’m sure the two of them can handle the class with no trouble at all.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Geoffrey 失散多年的儿子上周出现在我们家门口了，我相信他们两个应付那群学生完全不成问题。

lines.en: : Your butler never ceases to amaze me. But yes, I’m ready to go whenever.
lines.zh: : 你家管家总能让我大开眼界。不过，我随时都可以走了。

lines.en: : Great! Then let me just go grab my phone and we can get this show on the road!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那我去拿个手机，咱们就出发吧！

lines.en: scene halloweenfour23
: {i}Be back in a minute!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一分钟就回来！{/i}

lines.en: : Sensei, you’ve been really quiet all morning. And you didn’t even laugh at our Maya impressions. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你一早上都特别安静。我们模仿 Maya 你连笑都没笑。一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Has he ever laughed...well...{i}ever?{/i}
lines.zh: : 他有笑过吗……嗯……{i}有吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene halloweenfour24
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？

lines.en: : You’re looking all...{i}lost{/i} again. Are you feeling okay?
lines.zh: : 你看起来又是一副……{i}失神{/i}的样子。你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m fine...I just...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我没事……我只是……

lines.en: : My head’s felt a little weird since I got up this morning. And I’m having a little more trouble getting back to “normal” than usual.
lines.zh: : 今天早上起床后，我的头就一直有点不对劲。而且我比平时更难回到「正常」状态。

lines.en: : You too? I’ve felt a little out of it since I woke up as well. But I figured it was just about to rain or something.
lines.zh: : 你也是？我醒来后也一直有点恍惚。不过我以为只是要下雨之类的。

lines.en: : Strange thing to assume on account of there being so few instances of rain during our time here that we could count them all on one hand. But that’s too close to “universe talk” so I will speak on it no further.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的假设——我们在这里的日子里，下雨的次数少得一只手就数得过来。不过这太接近「宇宙话题」了，我就此打住。

lines.en: : Maya’s sudden interest in being a decent person aside, how is this after-party thing going to go? I haven’t heard any more about it since you told me at the pool.
lines.zh: : 先不提 Maya 突然想当个正经人，这个派对后的安排要怎么搞？自从你在泳池跟我说过之后，我就没再听说了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour25
: The SLS-
lines.zh: : SLS-

lines.en: : Which does not include me.
lines.zh: : 其中不包括我。

lines.en: : And Maya will be going out for a post-Halloween karaoke trip where I have promised to only sing Despacito one time.
lines.zh: : 而 Maya 会去参加万圣节后的卡拉 OK 之旅，我已经答应只唱一次 Despacito。

lines.en: : And to think Christmas came early {i}last{/i} year. This is even better.
lines.zh: : 想想{i}去年{/i}圣诞节提前来了。这次更好。

lines.en: : Is Sana still coming as well?
lines.zh: : Sana 也还是会来吧？

lines.en: scene halloweenfour26
: Yes. I invited Makoto too since she’s in on all the apocalypse business, but she’s not sure if she’ll be coming yet.
lines.zh: : 是的。我也邀请了 Makoto，毕竟她也掺和了末日那档事，但她还不确定来不来。

lines.en: : And speaking of the “apocalypse business,” what’s the situation like with Ami? I know the three of you have been...weird lately. But I’ve been mostly left out of it, so...
lines.zh: : 说到「末日那档事」，Ami 现在是什么情况？我知道你们三个最近……有点怪。但我基本上一直被排除在外，所以……

lines.en: : It’s fine enough for she and I to both dress as the same thing, so I wouldn’t worry too much about her right now.
lines.zh: : 她和我能扮成同一个人，说明情况还算可以，所以现在不用太担心她。

lines.en: : If anything, I think tonight might be a good way for her to start feeling included again after being left out of so much important stuff. So {i}I{/i} say we just try to have fun.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我觉得今晚或许是个好机会，让她在错过了那么多重要的事之后，重新觉得自己被接纳。所以{i}我{/i}说，我们就尽情玩吧。

lines.en: : Now here’s Maya with a rebuttal to that, likely concerning how having fun is a waste of time and that we should all just talk about her instead.
lines.zh: : 接下来是 Maya 的反驳时间，大概是说玩乐是浪费时间，我们不如都来聊聊她。

lines.en: scene halloweenfour27
: You’ll be hearing no rebuttal from me. I, too, would like to at least {i}attempt{/i} to adopt this new lease on life you’ve had as of late. It seems...refreshing.
lines.zh: : 你不会听到我的反驳。我也想至少{i}试着{/i}学学你最近这种新的人生态度。看起来……挺清爽的。

lines.en: : Do you think you’ll actually be able to? Does your brain even remember how fun works after all of those years of {i}not{/i} making out with Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你真能做到吗？在那么多年{i}没{/i}和 Sensei 亲热之后，你的脑子还记得「好玩」是怎么回事吗？

lines.en: scene halloweenfour28
: Oh, okay. So you just don’t {i}want{/i} me to have fun. I understand now.
lines.zh: : 哦，行吧。所以你就是{i}不想{/i}让我开心。我懂了。

lines.en: : You deserve to have fun just as much as the rest of us, Maya. I just won’t believe it until I see it.
lines.zh: : 你和我们其他人一样有资格开心，Maya。我只是要亲眼看到才会相信。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, feel free to stare as much as you want. It might help with that god-awful impression of yours.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那你就尽情看吧。说不定还能改善你那糟糕透顶的模仿。

lines.en: : Ooh! Are we doing our impressions again? I memorized a bunch of star facts in preparation for today. Listen up. Did you known that stars are luminous spheres made up of-
lines.zh: : 哦！又开始模仿了吗？我为了今天背了一堆星星冷知识。听好了。你知道星星是由-构成的发光球体吗？

lines.en: : There is more to my personality than just stars and the belittlement of everyone who is not me!
lines.zh: : 我的性格里可不止有星星，还有贬低所有不是我的人！

lines.en: : She’s right, Ami. Now, please pay attention for I have memorized a slew of {i}watermelon{/i} facts. Did you know the best way to tell if a melon is ripe is to-
lines.zh: : 她说得对，Ami。现在请注意听，我背了一大堆{i}西瓜{/i}知识。你知道判断西瓜熟不熟最好的办法是-

lines.en: : Aaaaahhhh!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: The girls wait for me to get dressed before heading out and, once I’m ready, we set off toward the Amamiya mansion for another {i}fun-{/i}filled night of costumes and candy.
lines.zh: 女孩们等我换好衣服再出发，等我准备好了，我们便动身前往 Amamiya 宅邸，去度过又一个充满{i}欢乐{/i}的服装与糖果之夜。

lines.en: scene clownguy
{b}AND WHATEVER IS INSIDE OF ME{/b}
lines.zh: {b}以及我体内的一切{/b}
